criteria.description: States the objective of adding an executable bit-exact CAN codec model in `modules.tools.gen_vehicle_protocol.frame_codec`.
States that `signal_layout` must slice signals identically to `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_protocols.py::get_byte_info` for `motorola` byte order.
States that generated output for accepted signals must remain unchanged.
Records the planned addition in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/extract_dbc_meta.py` to set `protocol["dlc"] = int(items[3])` on `BO_` lines.
Records the planned removal of the `if var_info["len"] <= 32` filter in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/extract_dbc_meta.py`.
Records the planned addition of an `apollo_py_binary` target named `frame_codec` to `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/BUILD`.
Records that the agent inferred `Byte::get_byte` semantics from `modules/drivers/canbus/common/byte.cc` without full un-truncated verification.
Names `modules/drivers/canbus/can_comm/protocol_data.h` as defining the `ProtocolData::BoundedValue` clamping semantics.
Names `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/apollo_demo.dbc` as having all signals in motorola `@0+` order.
Names `modules/canbus_vehicle/demo/proto/demo.proto` as containing `optional int32 vin15 = 1;`.
Records the planned `filter_protocol_vars(protocol)` helper in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py` returning `(supported_vars, skipped_names)`.
Records that `VIN15 : 63|16` in `vin_resp2` of `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/apollo_demo.dbc` yields byte 8.
Records that `modules/canbus_vehicle/demo/protocol/throttle_command_100.cc` slices `Speed_Target : 47|12@0+` as `[(5,0,8),(6,4,4)]`.
Records the planned design that `FrameCodec.encode` in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py` truncates a provided `data` buffer longer than `self.dlc` to `self.dlc` bytes.
Specifies the requirement that `signal_layout` raises `UnsupportedSignalError` when `signal["len"] > 32`.
Records the planned design that `FrameCodec.quantize` writes only one signal onto an all-zero `dlc` frame rather than using full `encode`, because other signals' defaults can have nonzero raw values.

Records the agent's finding (with `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_protocols.py` truncated before `get_byte_info`) that non-`motorola` byte order falls through to the `intel` path in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_protocols.py::get_byte_info`'s `else` branch.
Records the planned design that `SignalLayout` defines `__slots__ = ("_slices", "_bit_width")` in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py`.
Records the agent's reasoned design decision that `FrameCodec.encode` clamps only non-enum and non-bool signal types to mirror C++ `BoundedValue` behavior.
Records the agent's plan to leave `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_canbus_conf.py` untouched based on the agent's unverified inference that it does not iterate `vars`.
Records that the `if var["len"] > 32` block in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_protocols.py` is planned to be removed.
Records the planned design that `FrameCodec` in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py` treats extracted YAML signal names as-is (exact-case match) without lowercasing them.

Records that `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_protocols.py` plans to import `filter_protocol_vars` using `from modules.tools.gen_vehicle_protocol.frame_codec import filter_protocol_vars`, matching `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen.py`.
Records that the agent noted an unverified hypothesis of a `black_list` `KeyError` on `protocol["vars"]` in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/extract_dbc_meta.py`.

Records the planned `UnsupportedSignalError.__init__(signal_name, message=None)` signature in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py` providing a default error message when `message` is `None`.
Records that no files have been modified yet.
Specifies diffing accepted-signal generated output against `modules/canbus_vehicle/demo/protocol/*` as a pending verification step.

Specifies running `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_vehicle_controller_and_manager.py` on extracted YAML from `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/apollo_demo.dbc` as a pending verification step.
Contains at most 23600 characters.
Specifies writing a scratch sanity-test script in `/tmp/opencode` rather than placing test files inside `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/` as a pending verification step.
Records the planned placement of the normalization loop in `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_proto_file.py` right after `protocols = content["protocols"]`.
States that `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/frame_codec.py` has already been written.
States that `modules/tools/gen_vehicle_protocol/gen_canbus_conf.py` must be modified to skip unsupported signals.
States that `FrameCodec.quantize` is implemented by running full `encode` and then decoding the result.
